title: Pearl Abyss used generative AI to create paintings in Crimson Desert without disclosing it
content: Pearl Abyss has acknowledged that generative AI was used to create in-game paintings in Crimson Desert, following player discoveries of visual artifacts and watermark remnants consistent with AI image generation tools. The studio did not disclose AI asset usage prior to launch, sparking backlash from players and artists. Pearl Abyss stated the AI paintings were 'not supposed to be in the final game.'
